Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Path to close — proposed evaluation plan, roles, and timeline

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I've pulled together a short proposed evaluation plan and timeline to align on success criteria, stakeholders, and next steps so we can get you a working demo and measurement window before the end of Q1.

Key goals (as I heard them):
- Proof of concept: 3 pilot flows in your patient intake workflow (NLP extraction, triage classification, templated messaging).
- Quality targets: >= 92% extraction accuracy on the specified dataset; acceptable latency for synchronous flows (~<350ms median).
- Cost threshold: target cost per thousand tokens below your current benchmark; we will provide batching/quant suggestions.

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) Week of Nov 29: MAP kickoff — align stakeholders, finalize datasets, handoff to eng/CSM.
2) Dec 6–Dec 20: Integration & initial model tuning (private sandbox).
3) Jan 5–Jan 23: Measurement window (realistic traffic, agreed prompts/test set).
4) Feb 1: Review results, recommend go/no-go and pricing profile.

I've attached a one-page MAP template (redwood_map_template.xlsx) and an initial SOW draft for contract planning (SOW-draft-v1.pdf).

Can you confirm: (a) these goals reflect your priorities, and (b) the right stakeholders to bring into the kickoff next week — I recommend Tom for technical integration and someone from security if you want to run an early compliance checklist.

If that looks good, I'll schedule a 45-minute kickoff with Monica (our CSM) and Vivek (solutions lead) and share the MAP doc for collaborative editing.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
